<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 18:12">Targ. Y. I ib. XVIII, 12</cite> (<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 2">II</cite> <he>חייכ׳</he>). Targ. Y. ib. 15.
Targ. Ez. XXXII, 10; a. e.—Part. תְּמִיהַּ; f. תְּמִיהָא. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 ת׳ ומַתְמְהָא.—V. אֶתְמְהָא.—2) to be astonishing.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>אמר לי … והיא תַמְהָא</he> the elder of the Jews told me something, and that is astonishing; [perh. to be read <cite ref="V00653"><he>תִּמְהָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="V00456"><he>תֵּימַהּ</he></cite>].

senses.gloss: same. Targ. II Esth. l. c. Ib. מַתְמְהִין (some ed. מִתַּמְהִין, Ithpe.); a. e.

units: <cite ref="Zevachim 113a:12">Zeb. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>אַתְמוּהֵי מַתְמַהּ קרא</he> the text (<cite ref="Ezekiel 22:24">Ez. XXII, 24</cite>) expresses a query: thou, land of Israel! art thou not cleansed &c.?
